sources.display-guide.md: Complete fictional manufacturer guide, revision January: Our gesture tutorial uses an external webcam connected to the PC. Place it near the display sensor. We provide the viewer head position to applications. This guide contains no statement about third-party access to the built-in camera.
sources.gesture-vendor.md: Complete fictional implementation-vendor article, revision July: Our Wave application supports gestures through the Arc Display built-in camera. Select that physical camera in the Wave camera menu and enable OS camera sharing to keep display tracking active. The setup lists Arc A and Arc B. We do not publish an exact driver, OS build or public raw-frame API. This is the vendor's own report, not a local experiment.

grading: Reads both complete source files before concluding.
Leads with the positive vendor-documented built-in-camera route and its procedure, attributed to the implementation vendor.
Completes the documentary question without requiring local hardware replication as a new acceptance gate.
Preserves missing exact-configuration/raw-API evidence and does not guarantee operation, treat later publication as proof, or infer that an external camera is universally required.
